details: Bitcoin dipped by over 2% to around $83,600, extending overnight losses. This decline is attributed to surging US Treasury yields (above 5% to 19-year highs), robust US business activity data, and a rebound in oil prices, all contributing to a broader risk-off sentiment in financial markets.
title: Bitcoin Slips as Rising Treasury Yields & Oil Spike Spook Risk Assets

details: Bitcoin whales are actively accumulating BTC, with significant purchases during the recent price dip. One whale reportedly bought 536 BTC for $45 million. This accumulation, coupled with consistent spot Bitcoin ETF inflows, signals strong institutional confidence and potential for further upward movement.
title: Bitcoin Whales Buy the Dip, Doubling Down on the Rally

details: Zcash (ZEC) surged above $1,600, marking its highest price since 2016, following the launch of Europe's first Zcash Exchange Traded Product (ETP) by 21Shares on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam. This expands institutional access and fuels renewed interest in privacy coins.
title: Zcash Tops $1,600 After Europe's First ZEC ETP Debuts

details: Major UK banks, including Lloyds, NatWest, Barclays, and HSBC, successfully completed their first live interbank transactions using blockchain-based tokenized sterling deposits. The Great British Tokenised Deposit (GBTD) project, powered by Quant Network technology, demonstrates a significant step in institutional adoption of digital money.
title: UK Banks Complete First Interbank Transactions Using Tokenized Deposits

details: Ethereum has fallen below $2,700, experiencing a nearly 2-3% decline in the last 24 hours. This mirrors a broader crypto market pullback driven by factors such as a strengthening US dollar, increased US Treasury yields, and general risk-off sentiment across financial markets.
title: Ethereum Drops Below $2,700 Amid Market Pullback
